title: Separate callable hash fallback collisions from supported compiler inputs
applies_when: A Python JIT or compile cache hashes callable source, bytecode or captured values, and a proposed bug attributes every inline-constant difference to a missing co_consts field.
lesson: Trace the actual hash precedence before constructing a collision: an explicit __cute_hash__, a wrapped callable's hash, inspect.getsource, and only then the bytecode fallback can represent different paths. FlashAttention's source-visible controls can already distinguish literal changes; its co_code-only fallback is used when source inspection fails. CPython keeps literal payloads separately in co_consts, so source-unavailable functions can have equal bytecode and different behavior. A real helper collision still needs a supported consumer: wrapper construction is not kernel compilation or a wrong compiled-cache hit. Check the compiler's source-admission path before spending GPU time. CuTe's published frontend retrieves function source and rejects unsupported source-unavailable input; recheck the exact backend/version and any preprocessed or cached path rather than promoting a synthetic hash collision into a numerical kernel failure.
avoid_when: Do not turn one source-admission rejection into a universal no-bug verdict. Other compilers, explicit hashes, preprocessed functions or changed source contracts may admit a different path. A direct whole-module helper import is not the whole FlashAttention package, a compiled score/mask modifier, cache execution, GPU correctness or performance. The public sources establish mechanisms; the scoped native helper observation does not establish system-wide safety, Scout accuracy, lower total cost or PR conversion.

evidence.note: _compute_base_hash prefers inspect.getsource and reaches co_code only after inspection failure; hash_callable also has explicit/wrapped hash fast paths. This contradicts an unconditional bytecode-only explanation, not every fallback collision.
The code-object contract distinguishes bytecode instructions in co_code from literal values in co_consts. Equal instructions alone do not establish equal callable behavior.
Source retrieval can raise OSError or TypeError. Source availability must be tested independently of a function object's existence.

Mutable upstream frontend source retrieves source lines and rejects unsupported source-unavailable/REPL functions. Check the target version; this link is not an immutable wheel identity or an executed GPU failure.
